text:
Priya Desai: FYI incoming onboarding request from Driftwood Analytics — they want a private, multilingual summarizer with PHI safeguards. cc @Tom @Lina
Tom Alvarez: Dropping in — what model family/size are they asking for?
Priya Desai: Customer notes: prefer an open 13B variant, low-latency, must integrate with their onprem HSM for key management. Also want per-request audit logs.
Lina Park: Got it. Are they asking for Redwood Private (VPC) or full on-prem package?
Priya Desai: They said "private deployment (VPC or air-gapped if needed)" and will need HSM + SOC2 controls.
Tom Alvarez: Sounds like Private with HSM. Need sample prompts and expected QPS. Ask for dataset size and retention rules.
Priya Desai: I asked for sample docs and a 500-example testset for safety/eval. They replied with S3 link (private) and asked if we can run a red-team safety pass before go-live.
Eric Wu: Red-team OK — we can run safety evals and compare against our PHI-sensitive regression suite. Need someone to coordinate metric thresholds (precision/recall for entity masking, hallucination rate).
Lina Park: I'll own the safety/regression criteria. Can we get a baseline from them? If not, we'll create a small human-eval plan.
Rajat Shah: Renewal risk note — they flagged cost concerns (token volume) and latency under load. If we don't offer Dedicated or reserved bursts, they may look elsewhere.
Priya Desai: They asked for cost estimate for 13B quantized vs 70b distil — want guidance.
Tom Alvarez: Recommend quantized 13B + batching and prefix caching for summarization. Share a sample config: ```yaml
model: rw-13b-quantized
batching: auto
kv_cache: enabled
latency_slo: 250ms
```
Priya Desai: Also asked about A/B rollouts and automatic fallback to smaller models during capacity issues.
Eric Wu: Platform supports canary + fallback routing. We should propose a rollout plan: staging -> canary 5% -> 25% -> full with automatic fallback to rw-7b when latency > SLO.
Lina Park: For HSM/KMS integration: need their KMS endpoint, certs, and network egress rules. On-prem will need a deployment window for infra access.
Priya Desai: I scheduled an intake call with Driftwood for Tue 10am PT. They want an internal enablement session for their ML ops team.
Tom Alvarez: I'll join the intake and bring a short checklist: keys/certs, sample payloads, expected concurrency, retention policy, eval metrics.
Rajat Shah: From account health: this customer is mid-contract, heavy pilot usage — if onboarding stalls they'll churn. Treat as high-priority.
Priya Desai: Agreed. Lina, can you draft the safety evaluation plan by EOD Monday? Eric, can you prepare a cost/latency comparison table for 13B quantized vs 7B distil?
Eric Wu: Yep, will have a short spreadsheet and a few benchmark numbers.
Lina Park: Will draft tests and a red-team schedule. Need at least two annotators for PHI checks.
onboard-bot: Intake created: DRIFTWOOD-2026-001. Assigned: Priya, Lina, Tom. Next milestone: Intake call 2026-03-24 10:00 PT.
Priya Desai: Thanks all — I'll post the intake link and attach their sample set once we have access. :thumbsup:
Tom Alvarez: Quick note for the intake: ask them for a 30-minute runbook walkthrough for incident response and data deletion requests.
Priya Desai: Noted.
Lina Park: If we surface any safety regressions, recommend gating rollout until fixes or fallback rules are in place.
Rajat Shah: I'll flag renewal manager about the timeline and possible upsell (Dedicated burst) to mitigate risk.
Priya Desai: Great. Closing loop after intake.
